footer.commitment: Skillable is committed to providing an inclusive experience. We aim to align with WCAG 2.1 Level A/AA where possible and continuously improve.

home.heroSubtitle: Skillable matches you to careers using your actual profile — disabilities included, never excluded.
home.threeSteps: Three steps to your next opportunity

01.title: Build your profile
01.body: Set your accessibility needs, experience level, and skills. The more detail, the sharper your matches.

02.title: Get matched
02.body: Our algorithm scores every career across disability accommodation, skill overlap, and experience fit.

03.title: Start learning
03.body: Pick a track, follow the roadmap, fill skill gaps with curated resources — at your own pace.

home.aiSubtitle: Ask me anything about your career
home.aiEmptyMsg: Ask about jobs, accessibility laws, interview tips, or anything career-related.
home.simplifierSubtitle: Paste any job description or document. We'll rewrite it in plain, clear language.

matching.title: Career matching built around you
matching.body: Our algorithm scores every job across 4 accessibility dimensions — mobility, vision, hearing, and cognitive — then layers in your skills and experience to rank your best fits.

tracks.title: Structured learning paths
tracks.body: Frontend, Backend, Full Stack — each track is broken into phases with curated resources, skill checklists, and gap analysis that compares what you know to what you need.

ai.title: A career advisor, always on
ai.body: Ask about accessibility laws, interview prep, or how to explain a gap in your CV. Powered by Gemini — answers are concise, practical, and tuned for job seekers with disabilities.

textTools.title: Complex text made simple
textTools.body: Paste any job description and get an Easy Read version — plain language, short sentences, no jargon. Useful for cognitive accessibility or just cutting through corporate speak.

cv.title: A CV that speaks for itself
cv.body: Generate a clean, structured CV from your profile in one click. Download as PDF. No formatting headaches, no blank-page anxiety.

remote.title: Location should never be a barrier
remote.body: We surface and prioritize remote and hybrid roles — because for many people with disabilities, proximity to an office is the first and biggest obstacle.
